report.summary: Patient P-D007 (age 66, Original Medicare, no supplemental plan, home census tract 17031681000) requested food resource options. Four food resources were identified near the patient's home tract: two community pantries/fridges, a Saturday market pantry for Cook County residents, and a benefits screener for SNAP/WIC/LIHEAP. Eligibility is limited where noted (Cook County residency; no ID required at one pantry). No detailed income-based eligibility could be verified from the records alone.

options.name: Madison Street Community Fridge (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Open daily 8 AM-8 PM; take what you need.

options.name: Saturday Market Pantry (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Saturdays 9 AM-noon. Eligibility: Cook County residents.

options.name: Northwest Side Food Pantry (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Open Mon/Wed/Fri 12-3 PM; no ID required; fresh produce Wednesdays.
